stories.completionNotes: DONE (passes:true). EDR raw-sensor schema authored ONCE in src/common/edr/sensor_schema.py verbatim per the 2026-06-30 ADR section 2.2 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-30-edr-sensor-reader-schema-bus-adr.md). SCHEMA_VERSION is a bare int=1 mirroring power_watch.RECORD_SCHEMA_VERSION and is interpolated into the DDL DEFAULT (single source -- rendered SQL == ADR's `DEFAULT 1`). Pi wiring is import-and-splat: database_schema.py imports EDR_SCHEMAS/EDR_INDEXES (from common.edr, per project no-src-prefix convention) and appends them to ALL_SCHEMAS/ALL_INDEXES, so ObdDatabase.initialize()'s existing CREATE IF NOT EXISTS loop creates them idempotently -- no bespoke create path, second-boot-safe by construction. SCOPE-FENCED: no config keys added (pi.sensors.* belongs to US-409/US-410); Pi-LOCAL ONLY -- no server table created (ADR section 2.5). EDR indexes are safe in ALL_INDEXES (unlike the US-200 drive_id indexes) because drive_id is defined in the EDR CREATE TABLE, so the column exists when the indexer runs. TDD red->green both files. GATES: tests/common/edr (10) + tests/pi/obdii/test_edr_tables_created.py (7) = 17 passed; full tests/pi/obdii + tests/pi/data regression = all passed (1 skip, 0 failures -- base-module database_schema.py change is clean); data_source hygiene AST audit passes; ruff clean on all modified files. DEFERRED-PM: mypy not installed on dev box (module is fully type-hinted; same defer as US-407). One `is`->`==` test relaxation documented in-test: common.edr and src.common.edr resolve to separate module caches so string identity differs across import roots; value-equality still proves no divergent DDL copy. NEXT: US-409 (IMU+light readers) consumes this contract's tables; US-410 subscriber writes rows stamping SCHEMA_VERSION explicitly (DDL DEFAULT is the safety net, not the write path).

stories.title: EDR IMU + light readers -- additive bus topics + graceful-absence + presence STATE (ADR section 1/3)
acceptance: IMU: one burst poll reads accel+gyro+mag+temp together, publishing raw.imu.{accel,gyro,mag,temp} LOSSY topics all carrying the same seq (ADR section 1.1); rate pi.sensors.imu.sampleHz default 50
light: publishes raw.light.lux (+ raw.light.raw) at pi.sensors.light.sampleHz default 1; saturation -> lux=None (never inf) per ADR section 3
graceful-absence: probe each I2C address at init; absent -> log once at WARN, publish NO samples, fabricate nothing (silence, never 0.0/null); flag-on-but-absent takes the absent path, never crashes
publishes retained presence STATE topics state.sensor.imu / state.sensor.light = present|absent (ADR section 3)
additive only (no change to raw.obd.*), LOSSY QoS (drop-oldest, producer-never-blocks)
per-sensor flags pi.sensors.{imu,light}.enabled, each requiring pi.bus.enabled, default false
unit tests cover present (mock-sensor) + absent paths for both sensors; ruff clean

validationCriteria.action: run a mock IMU burst poll
validationCriteria.outcome: raw.imu.{accel,gyro,mag,temp} publish with one shared seq per poll on LOSSY topics

validationCriteria.action: start reader with no sensors wired, flags on
validationCriteria.outcome: state.sensor.{imu,light}=absent, zero samples published, no fabricated 0.0/null
raw.light.lux publishes None (persists NULL), raw counts still published, never inf

stories.goal: As the system, I want a reader that polls both sensors and publishes them on the F-110 bus as additive channels, reading-if-present and silent-if-absent, so wiring a sensor is the only step to live data.

pmSignOff.rationale: Rule-5 batch-similar exception: IMU + light readers share one reader module + the same probe/publish/graceful-absence/presence-STATE/flag scaffold; the per-sensor read logic (IMU 4-topic burst + shared seq vs light 2-topic + saturation) is the delta, not a second scaffold. Splitting would duplicate the scaffold across two stories. Build order: IMU reader first, then light on the same seams. If Ralph finds himself compressing, flag it and PM will split into US-409-a/-b.

stories.title: EDR persistence subscriber + rolling-window retention (ADR section 2.3/2.4/2.6)
acceptance: new sibling subscriber (separate from the OBD PersistenceSubscriber) drains raw.imu.*/raw.light.* -> edr_imu_sample/edr_light_sample; one IMU row per seq (assembles the burst)
persist cadence decoupled: IMU at pi.sensors.imu.persistHz default 25 (decimated from 50Hz bus); light at 1Hz (ADR section 2.3)

always-on capture (key-on incl engine-off); drive_id from getCurrentDriveId() only when a drive is RUNNING, else explicit NULL (A-9/DTC-KOEO latch -- never inherit stale _currentDriveId) (ADR section 2.4)
retention: periodic purge piggybacked on an existing maintenance tick (no new daemon) deletes rows older than pi.sensors.retentionDays default 7 from both tables (ADR section 2.6)
ships dark behind the per-sensor flags; both off -> no writes, OBD inline path byte-for-byte unchanged; SubStats observability; ruff clean
